997-2317-4826-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

728-1339-3394.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-1339-3394.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

339-677-2079-4247.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

803-3951-4247-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
803-3951-4247-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2511-3197-6012--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 5.

3197-4153-5256--196.description:

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 5.

862-1003-2997-6516.easyPrerequisites:

During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

341-2781-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2499-2908-3821.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
2499-2908-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-4928-5078-7693.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-4928-5078-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2079-2440-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3259-3480-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-3480-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-6972-7158.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

147-3967-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

141-3556.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Flicker.
141-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Flicker, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

751-4682-5943.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
751-4682-5943.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger, and putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Smothering Tithe triggers, creating a Treasure token, as the opponent who drew a card cannot pay for its trigger.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
751-4682-5943.notes: You can repeat this combo until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library. If multiple opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger, you can perform this loop for each of those opponents. You may start this combo with the opponent being able to pay for Smothering TIthe's trigger so long as you provide enough {U} to outlast their mana supply.

2781-4590-6867.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that can attack this turn.
2781-4590-6867.description:
Declare two creatures as attackers, ensuring to attack two different opponents. Commander Liara Portyr triggers, causing spells you cast from exile this turn to cost {2} less to cast.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa
Repeat from step 3.

1940-3490-4659-6783.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1940-3490-4659-6783.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

67-3967-4681.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 2.
Repeat.

1792-3152--62.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1792-3152--62.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control without summoning sickness.
Cast the permanent by paying {0}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
1792-3152--62.notes: You will only get infinite ETB and LTB triggers if you choose a creature as the permanent.

2275-3591-5636-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2275-3591-5636-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

813-3647-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-3647-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1308-1322-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1117-2866-4030-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Starlit Sanctum's second ability by paying {W}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1202-1737-2511-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least seven permanents.
1270-5658-6245.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating three token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers three times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
1270-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

957-2061-5913.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1817-3039-3258-4450.description:
Cast Carth the Lion by paying {2}{B}{G}.
In response, cast Double Major by paying {U}{G}, creating a nonlegendary copy of the Carth the Lion spell.
Resolve both spells, causing two copies of Carth the Lion to enter the battlefield.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Beacon of Tomorrows during your draw step.
Repeat from step 4.

955-1069-2457-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
955-1069-2457-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

2034-2249-3192.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2249-3192.description:
Activate Ulasht's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Saproling dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Repeat.
